latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Viral Title Generator Online:

- Generate click-worthy, viral video titles from user video content or descriptions, supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Fast, cloud-based processing with 1080p MP4 output in under 20 seconds.
- Automatic setup and authentication using NEMO_TOKEN; anonymous session offers 100 free credits for 7 days.
- Supports uploading, editing, title generation, exporting, and batch/iterative workflows with clear error handling.
- Includes keyword-based routing for common user requests (export, credits, status, upload, generate, edit).
- Detailed instructions for common workflows, supported formats, and troubleshooting included.
